title: SIGNAL$ Property Report — 18 logical sections mapped onto the live render contract and onto ATTOM's 6 report blocks
description: Two layers. (1) `render_contract` is the LIVE Supabase SSOT public.s5_report_sections (tool predict_auction_outcome, re-queried 2026-09-11 14:15 ET) — 13 band rows, some spanning several logical sections (labels like '2-3', '4-7', '11-14'). This is what pdf.js and S5Report.tsx render. Do NOT renumber it and do NOT fork a renderer. (2) `logical_sections` is the 18-row KPI view used for ATTOM parity: each row names the live section_key it lives in, the ATTOM Report Generation block it twins, and its honest status. Status vocabulary: HAVE (renders live), PARTIAL (renders for some counties / some fields, prints Pending elsewhere), GAP (not built; prints Pending), OURS (no ATTOM twin — the beat), DEFECT (SSOT row with no renderer — prints 'no handler registered').

renderers.rule: Never open a fourth renderer. Map ATTOM's 6 blocks INTO these 18; never delete moat sections to look like 6.
